A.name: Narragansett sachem-line woman
A.confirm: A contemporaneous document securely connects Joan or her household to an Indigenous person, community, kin group, or name tradition.
A.disconfirm: A primary record securely identifies Joan elsewhere, or a comparable frontier-wife baseline explains the silence without this model.
A.caution: Absence from English records is not evidence of Indigenous identity. Respect community access protocols.

B.name: English woman, undocumented
repositories: New England town and church records
B.confirm: A dated parish, migration, marriage, or colonial record links an English Joan to this household and place.
B.disconfirm: A secure record identifies a non-English origin or status, or the candidate fails the date/place/household test.
B.caution: The English name Joan is not proof of English origin.

C.name: Irish origin
C.confirm: A contemporaneous record links Joan or a secure household associate to Ireland, Ulster, or an Irish migration route.
C.disconfirm: A documented alternative origin is established or every candidate fails identity, date, and place anchors.
C.caution: Y-DNA of a male line cannot identify Joan's origin.

D.name: Indentured servant
repositories: RI, Massachusetts, Connecticut, and Plymouth court records
D.confirm: A record names Joan or a secure alias as servant, indentured, apprenticed, or released from a term.
D.disconfirm: A contemporaneous record establishes a different status or the proposed person fails the household and date anchors.
D.caution: Occupation, poverty, or missing parents do not prove servitude.

E.name: Enslaved person
repositories: RI, Massachusetts, and Connecticut disposal records
E.confirm: A contemporaneous record uses status language for Joan or securely identifies her in an enslaved/captive household context.
E.disconfirm: A reliable record establishes free status before marriage or securely identifies another person.
E.caution: Colonial labels must be quoted and contextualized; race, name, and absence cannot establish status.

F.name: Widow of prior marriage
F.confirm: A dated probate, marriage, dower, or guardianship record links a Joan with a prior husband to John Greene's household.
F.disconfirm: A record identifies Joan's first marriage or maiden identity without a prior husband, or the candidate fails the anchors.
F.caution: Legal standing alone does not prove widowhood.

G.name: Joan Beggarly / Alice Daniels (La Mance)
G.confirm: Only reopen if a primary record overturns the chronology and identifies the 1682 Joan as this person.
G.disconfirm: Chronological mismatch, wrong John, or wrong town remains documented.
G.caution: This is an audit target for citation contamination, not a preferred live hypothesis.

H.name: Mixed-heritage English/Narragansett parentage
H.confirm: A contemporaneous record links Joan's household to an English–Narragansett family, kin group, interpreter, or documented parentage.
H.disconfirm: A secure alternative identity is established or the proposed connection depends only on geography or silence.
H.caution: Mixed heritage is not inferred from location, name, appearance, or documentary absence.
